task: Making fried egg and tomato toast
query: How do I make fried egg and tomato toast?

goal.title: Make an egg and tomato toast sandwich
goal.description: Toast two bread slices, rinse and slice a tomato, cook egg in an oiled frying pan, then place tomato and cooked egg between the toast slices.
goal.final_state: A closed egg and tomato sandwich rests on a white plate.
procedure: Load bread into the toaster, connect it and start toasting.
Rinse and dry the tomato, then cut it into thin slices.
Heat a frying pan, add oil, crack egg into a bowl and pour it into the pan.
Break the yolk with a silicone spatula and allow the egg to cook, occasionally shaking the pan and checking the watch timer.
Remove the toast, arrange tomato slices on one piece, transfer the egg with a wooden spatula and close the sandwich.

phases.description: Two bread slices are loaded, the toaster is plugged in and its controls are adjusted to start heating.
The tomato is rinsed at the faucet, dried with paper towel and sliced repeatedly on the cutting board.
Stove controls are set, the pan is positioned, and oil is poured into it before the bottle is put aside.
Egg is cracked into the bowl, carried to the stove and tipped into the frying pan; the bowl is set in the sink.
The yolk is broken and egg spread with a silicone spatula, the watch is checked, and the pan is shaken and stirred between waits.
A plate is moved beside the toaster. The wearer checks toaster and watch controls, waits and repeatedly shakes the pan as the egg sets.
The two toast slices are removed from the toaster and arranged on the plate; tomato slices are added and adjusted across one slice.
The pan is lifted, a wooden spatula is taken and used to scrape cooked egg onto the tomato toast. The pan is returned and the second toast slice placed on top.
